description:
Title: Becoming A Parent

Create a process that support in planning, taking and extending a maternity leave.  
* Fetch information about potential models (months duration, split between parents) 
* Let parent select 
* Collect relevant information 
* Notify Social Security, Company in time 
* Gather information from companies 
* At the end of the period let parent decide about extension.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_BecomingAParent"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/becoming-a-parent">

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BecomingAParent">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Parent" name="Parent" processRef="Process_Parent"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SocialSecurity" name="Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifySS" name="Leave notification"
                      sourceRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Participant_SocialSecurity" messageRef="Message_LeaveNotificationSS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyCompany" name="Leave notification"
                      sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Participant_Company" messageRef="Message_LeaveNotificationCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyInfo" name="Company information"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="ManualTask_GatherCompanyInfo" messageRef="Message_CompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ExtensionNotifySS" name="Extension notification"
                      sourceRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurityExtension" targetRef="Participant_SocialSecurity" messageRef="Message_ExtensionNotificationSS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ExtensionNotifyCompany" name="Extension notification"
                      sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyCompanyExtension" targetRef="Participant_Company" messageRef="Message_ExtensionNotificationCompany"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_LeaveNotificationSS" name="Maternity leave notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LeaveNotificationCompany" name="Maternity leave notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyInformation" name="Company information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExtensionNotificationSS" name="Leave extension notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExtensionNotificationCompany" name="Leave extension notification"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Parent" name="Becoming A Parent - Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Supports planning, taking and extending a maternity leave.</bpmn:documentation>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PlanLeave" name="Leave planning started"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_FetchLeaveModels" name="Fetch leave models (duration in months, split between parents)"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_SelectLeaveModel" name="Select leave model"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepSplit" name="Start preparations"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_CollectRelevantInformation" name="Collect relevant information"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security in time" messageRef="Message_LeaveNotificationSS"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyCompany" name="Notify Company in time" messageRef="Message_LeaveNotificationCompany"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_GatherCompanyInfo" name="Gather information from companies"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepJoin" name="Preparations completed"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_LeavePeriodEnded" name="Leave period ended">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_LeavePeriodEnded"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_DecideExtension" name="Decide about leave extension"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" name="Extension requested?" default="Flow_ExtensionNo"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurityExtension" name="Notify Social Security about extension" messageRef="Message_ExtensionNotificationSS"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyCompanyExtension" name="Notify Company about extension" messageRef="Message_ExtensionNotificationCompany"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LeaveExtended" name="Leave extended"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LeaveEnded" name="Leave ended"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_PlanLeave" targetRef="ManualTask_FetchLeaveModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="ManualTask_FetchLeaveModels" targetRef="ManualTask_SelectLeaveModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="ManualTask_SelectLeaveModel" targetRef="Gateway_PrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="ManualTask_CollectRelevantInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="ManualTask_GatherCompanyInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="ManualTask_CollectRelevantInformation" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="ManualTask_GatherCompanyInfo" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepJoin" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_LeavePeriodEnded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_LeavePeriodEnded" targetRef="ManualTask_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="ManualTask_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtensionYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurityExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtensionNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_LeaveEnded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurityExtension" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyCompanyExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyCompanyExtension" targetRef="EndEvent_LeaveExtended"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
